new.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides that 'there shall be equality of opportunity for all citizens in matters relating to employment or appointment to any office under the State'?
new.x: Article 16(1) guarantees equality of opportunity in public employment to all citizens.

new.s: Which element of Dicey's Rule of Law means that regular law is supreme and the powers of the Government are limited?
new.x: Dicey's first element, absence of arbitrary power, means regular law is supreme and limits government power; this idea of limited government is the core of constitutionalism.
new.angle: U0283 PYQ yeb9d2e8a095 limitation of powers angle

new.s: Which of the following does Article 14 permit?
new.x: Article 14 forbids class legislation but permits reasonable classification based on intelligible differentia with a rational nexus to the law's object.
new.angle: U0283 #14 PYQ y8a85812970c class legislation vs classification

new.s: Under which Article does the President appoint a commission to investigate the conditions of socially and educationally backward classes?
new.x: Article 340 lets the President appoint a commission on the conditions of SEBCs; 338B is the NCBC and 342A the Central List.
new.angle: U0283 notes gap Art. 340 commission

new.s: In which case did the Supreme Court hold that there can be no reservation in promotions?
new.x: Indra Sawhney (1992) barred reservation in promotions; the 77th Amendment (1995) then inserted Article 16(4A).
new.angle: U0283 #7 notes gap Indra Sawhney no promotions

new.s: Who among the following are immune from civil and criminal proceedings in India under international law?
o: Members of State Public Service Commissions
new.x: Under international law, foreign sovereigns, ambassadors, diplomats and UN agencies are immune from civil and criminal proceedings, an exception to equality before law.
new.angle: U0283 N1 exceptions to equality - diplomatic immunity
